decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed eight covered trolley bays and the paladin mesh security fencing, because of their size, position,  appearance and design would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of the Tesco shopping area and 
complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and  would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and  neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) ENVB 1.9 (Safety and Security) and S 4.1 ( Environmental Improvements to shopping  areas)  of the UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the structures are used.
description: Erection of 8 covered trolley bays, canopy with 2400mm high palladin mesh security fencing.
